title: Boots of Arcane Bolstering

sources.title: Rapid Caster
markers: | description = Each time they {{SAI|Dash}}, the wearer gains {{Cond|Arcane Charge}} for 2 turns.

summary: Dashing grants Arcane Charge for 2 turns, and another Dash cannot raise its duration above 2. Arcane Charge adds 2 spell damage against Threatened targets, despite the item tooltip.

fields.Effect: Dashing grants Arcane Charge for 2 turns, and another Dash cannot raise its duration above 2. Arcane Charge adds 2 spell damage against Threatened targets, despite the item tooltip.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
